question: Kati Bihu, one of the three Bihu festivals of Assam, is celebrated in the month of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**October.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kati Bihu** is one of the **three Bihu festivals** celebrated in **Assam, India.**
 
• This festival is celebrated in the **month of October,** which is also known as** Kati month **in the **Assamese calendar.**
 
• Kati Bihu is also known as **Kangali Bihu **or the festival of the poor, as it falls in the month when **farmers face scarcity of food **and are dependent on the next harvest.
 
• During Kati Bihu, **people light lamps** and offer prayers to **Goddess Lakshmi **to seek her blessings for a good harvest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other festivals celebrated in Assam are** Baishagu, Ali-Ai-Ligang, Baikho, Rongker, Rajini Gabra Harni Gabra, Bohaggiyo Bishu, Ambubashi Mela and Jonbill Mela.**
